quarterly_data.quarter: Lam Research press release: Lam Research Breaks Ground on New Oregon Lab to Accelerate (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lam started construction of a new 120,000-square-foot lab at its Tualatin, Oregon R&D center, the first milestone of its more than $3 billion planned global lab network expansion. The lab is expected to increase cleanroom lab space at the Tualatin R&D center by more than 50% and is projected to open in 2028, adding deposition and etch process development, materials science and hardware validation capabilities where customers work on-site with Lam engineers. COO Sesha Varadarajan: it will add 'tens of thousands of square feet of valuable cleanroom space, enabling even closer collaboration with customers'.
quarterly_data.figure: 120,000 sq ft Oregon lab; cleanroom lab space at Tualatin up more than 50%; opening projected 2028
